objective: Solutions of zero and negative values
constraints: right side is 1 or a unit fraction; solutions are 0 or negative integers -1 to -4
hints: Recognize that one is any nonzero base to exponent zero, while a unit fraction can be written with a negative exponent.
Rewrite the right side as the same base raised to zero or a negative power.
Match the exponents of the common base to determine the unknown.

constraints: bases 4, 5, 10 with the right side a larger power of the base; integer solutions 3-6
hints: Express the larger number as repeated multiplication of the given base.
Write both sides with the same base and compare the powers rather than using a decimal approximation.
The exponent that builds the right-hand power is the solution to the equation.
